name: ListingScene
original_description: ListingScene is owned and operated by AI Software Ltd. Virtually furnish rooms and enhance real estate photos with your connected ListingScene account. Choose a room type, preview nine furniture styles, and adjust lighting, color, perspective, visible sky, or small clutter. Stage an enhanced photo or enhance a staged photo, in either order. Compare the result with the original, download it, and retrieve saved results. Supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP photos under 25 MB. Each completed edit uses your existing account allowance. AI edits can change visible details: review results before publishing and label virtual staging. ListingScene does not publish listings or guarantee MLS compliance.
summary_ja: 不動産写真の家具配置や明るさなどを調整し、元画像と比較する。
limitations_ja: 接続済みアカウントの利用枠を消費。画像の細部が変わる場合があり、掲載前の確認と仮想ステージングの明示を求める。
